evidence.quote:
/* Limits how deeply nested arrays/objects can be before cJSON rejects to parse them.
 * This is to prevent stack overflows. */
#ifndef CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT
#define CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT 1000
#endif

mkdir build
cd build
cmake -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DENABLE_CJSON_TEST=OFF ..
make -j$(nproc)

$CXX $CXXFLAGS $SRC/cjson/fuzzing/cjson_read_fuzzer.c -I. \
    -o $OUT/cjson_read_fuzzer \
    $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE $SRC/cjson/build/libcjson.a

observable_consequence.reason: With a limit of 1000, the print guard returns false and the print variants return NULL, while the target returns on parse failure before calling them. Whether that exact depth rejection exists in the configured build is unresolved.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: At limit 1000, all three print choices receive only the parsed tree, and minify edits a separate text copy after printing. A higher effective limit could let a natural 1001-array input reach the print operation, so the configuration is decisive.

identity_preserved.reason: The assessment consistently concerns printing a 1001-array chain and reaching print_array at depth 1000. The supplied g0001 diff adds that depth guard; the same old harness is used throughout this assessment.
